name: Aeon ★ Aha
description:
Cries and comedy intertwine, and the deathly still cosmos awakens to daybreak in a farce.
Stepping back onto the stage of the Path, I tear off the god's mask. Who is Aha? I am Aha!
To play, to trick, to hunt... Please bear witness to an improv tour where humans and gods dance as one!

skills.name: Starfrost, Showtime!

extra.name: Elation DMG
extra.desc:

Elation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

skills.name: This Emanator Was Certified by Aha™
skills.desc: Enables one designated ally character (excluding this unit) to gain the "Emanator of Elation" state, then immediately launches Follow-up ATK, dealing #2[i]% Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies. The "Emanator of Elation" state lasts for the entire battle until it switches to the next target. The target with the "Emanator of Elation" state has their Elation stat increased by #1[i]% and, at the start of their turn, enables Aeon ★ Aha to gain #6[i] point(s) of "Wishpower."

skills.desc: Aha's action advances by #5[i]%. Aeon ★ Aha gains the "Faces of Elation" state, lasting for #6[i] turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Aeon ★ Aha's every turn. skills.simpleDesc: Aha's action advances. Aeon ★ Aha gains the "Faces of Elation" state. Deals massive Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies. Then, deals Quantum Elation DMG to random single enemies, bouncing a total of #3[i] time(s).

extra.name: Aha
extra.desc:
When taking action, triggers an Aha Instant and causes units capable of using Elation Skills to each use their Elation Skill 1 time. If there are no units capable of using Elation Skills when Aha takes action, Aha will use "Let There Be Laughter."
The Aha Instant lasts until the final Elation Skill finishes this time.
When the Aha Instant ends, participating characters gain the "Certified Banger" state for the Punchline points taken into account this time, lasting for 2 turns. After Aha takes action, all Punchlines will be consumed.

extra.name: "Elation" Path Ascension
extra.desc: While Aeon ★ Aha holds the "Faces of Elation" state, "Punchline" and "Certified Banger" get enhanced to "Bliss" and "Party Trick" respectively, and ally characters on the Path of Elation will activate their "Innate Trace" effects.

extra.name: Certified Banger
extra.desc:
Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.
Punchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.
The duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

extra.name: Bliss
extra.desc: Gaining Bliss is considered as gaining Punchline. At the end of the Aha Instant, a portion of the consumed value is regained as Bliss.

extra.name: Party Trick
extra.desc: When gaining the "Party Trick" state, it is considered as gaining the "Certified Banger" state. The "Party Trick" value will affect the "Innate Trace" effects of Elation ally characters.
